notes:
Top-line: outfit live-game personalization & in-match assistants. Very latency- and cost-sensitive. Current infra: mixed cloud + private colos; experimenting with on-prem GPU racks for EU region.

Constraints / asks: p95 tail targets: <=50ms for short-turn chat (player prompts), p99 goal: <=120ms at 800-1,200 RPS sustained; willing to trade model size for quantization if quality loss <= 2% NLG BLEU-like metric. Strong emphasis on unit economics — target token cost <$0.0006 for production paths.

Performance & architecture interest: batching window tuning (want Redwood Optimize defaults + recommended max latency window), intelligent KV/prefix caching for recurring player context, 4-bit/8-bit quantization profiles; compare INT8 vs 4-bit for 13B-class models. Need clear kernel/runtime perf numbers (A10G vs H100 vs V100) for our seq len distro (avg 80 tokens).

POC history: quick demo (12/03) with Willow SE — demo showed 30% cost reduction with caching but tail spikes at peak. Follow-ups: "Can you force a canary using smaller quantized model + fallback to fp16?" (quote from CTO).

Security/compliance: must support SSO + enterprise SAML, audit logging with 90-day retention, EU data residency for match logs. On-prem package required for regulated EU tournaments.

Customer quotes: "We need predictable tail latency more than peak throughput — players notice jitter." — Head of Live Ops.

Link references: perf metrics doc in Drive, Fireflies transcripts of demo calls, initial security FAQ (drive).
